title: Recover a depressurized ATI QC-001 tool plate with support
instruction: Support the tool plate. Use the handled ball-end key to press the release piston while supporting the plate. Withdraw the tool and park it in the stand.
context: Recover an end effector on a research robot when pneumatic unlock is unavailable.
setup: Unpowered, depressurized QC-001 envelope on a bench, fitting removed. Captive guided 1.5 mm ball-end-key surrogate, aluminum tool body with blue grip and a separate ABS rest. Master datum (286, 0) mm and stand datum (286, 197) mm. Tool plate starts 22 mm above the bench.
scoring: 0.25 for 0.20 s continuous support before unlock. 0.65 after at least 7 mm piston stroke through the key with support and no more than 2 mm drop over the first 0.30 s. 1.00 after one second stably released in the stand. Unlock without support or a drop above 2 mm sets score to zero.
reset_notes: Recouple the plate, reset release piston and guided key, clear the stand, and check that stroke starts at zero.
fidelity: Original drawing-inspired envelope. Captive key and force-based recoupled latch model an 11 mm bench stroke. OEM travel and access need measurement.
